name: SEP Draw
subtitle: Security CAD for iPad
promotionalText: Draw IDS, access control, infrastructure & CCTV — Visio, AutoCAD & PDF in one iPad app.
description:
SEP Draw is the native iPad drawing studio in Security Estimator Pro™ for security and low-voltage professionals.

Design on-site for:
• Intrusion (IDS)
• Access control
• Video surveillance with FOV coverage
• Network / infrastructure pathways
• AV & intercom schematics

Built to replace a patchwork of tools — key workflows from System Surveyor, D-Tools, SiteOwl, JVSG, IPVM, XTEN-AV, Jetbuilt, Axis Site Designer, Vectorworks ConnectCAD, Specifi, ConEst, magicplan, Bluebeam, and Simply Wise — in one App Store app.

Import Visio (.vsdx), AutoCAD (.dxf/.dwg), and PDF floor plans. Export PDF, DXF, Visio XML, and BOM CSV. Place Visio/CAD security symbols, run coverage cones, mark up sheets, and roll estimates into proposals.

Survey. Design. Defend.

Publisher: NVSSMD, LLC
reviewNotes: SEP Draw is an offline-capable iPad design utility. No login required. Tap Load Sample Campus on the welcome screen to evaluate drawing, coverage, estimating, and import/export menus. Document picker is used for Visio, DXF/DWG, and PDF import only. Current App Store screenshots in the repo are labeled PLACEHOLDER — replace with simulator captures before final submit.
